shown.message:
I checked the paper's page count again and found the main text has almost no room under the 8-page limit. I posted that on `paper-repo`#4.

- **Page limit:** in the built PDF of `fd6acaf` the main text ends on the last line of page 8. The Impact Statement and AI Disclosure open page 9. One extra line would push the body onto page 9, which ICML rejects automatically. I asked `paper-repo` to keep about 0.3 page free and to re-check the page of the last Discussion line on the build of the commit it offers for approval.
- **Newer build:** that build is older than `paper-repo`'s latest commit (`020ef16`), which had not reached the `document` branch yet. The page count therefore needs re-checking on the newer build.
- **References:** `references.bib` now has 26 entries at `020ef16`, up from 12. That is inside the 22 to 85 range of my 10-paper sample, though below its median of about 43. I asked only that every entry be verified.
- **Fonts and style:** all 40 fonts in the PDF are Type 1, and the style file is unmodified.

I did not re-check ICML's promised submission-process update this turn. I'll do that before a version is approved.
